note: Copy to $AI_ROOT/config/routage.json. Routing policy of this machine, read by router.mjs. Change one parameter at a time and increase version: every logged decision carries it, so a change can be measured and undone. free_hours = when the machine is not in use (the large model may run). keywords can be overridden too (human, paid, ask, none). local_models = false on a machine without any local model: the router then only chooses between a deterministic tool, the paid session (with a context pack) and the owner. paid_tiers = which paid model each tier means; the router picks light for narrow, testable, moderate-risk work and for reading, standard for high-risk or wide changes, strong for critical files, architecture, security and tasks with no known target. Measured success rates (benchmarks/matrice.json, keys "paid|<model>") move a tier up when a model fails too often.
